title: Inspector Pelt
kicker: a checkpoint compliance officer terrified of being blamed
hook: a checkpoint compliance officer terrified of being blamed

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A round-eyed ribbet inspector sits beneath hanging seals in a purple sash, clutching forms, stamps, and a frog-stiff posture that begs nobody to shout.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: Fear filed neatly under compliance. Sits frog-stiff beneath his hanging seals, begging nobody to shout. Wears, hidden under the sash, the route-token of the first traveler he ever waved through for free.
